source: GitHub Advisory Database, reviewed advisories (CC-BY-4.0), via the REST /advisories API

criteria.scope: advisory CWEs, expanded with tools/ground_truth/cve_pairs.py CWE_ALIASES, meet the CWE tags of the language pack's security-dimension rules (src/arbiter/packs/rules/ast/<lang>.yaml)
criteria.fix_reference: first GitHub /commit/<sha> or /pull/<n>/commits/<sha> reference that qualifies
criteria.order: sha256('<seed>:<ghsa_id>') ascending, independent of API order
criteria.split: per repository, all languages at once: sealed when sha256('<seed>:split:<repo lower>') / 2^256 < sealed_fraction; gold development repositories (tools/fetch_corpus.sh pins not held out) are kept in development
criteria.excluded_repositories: every repository of an already-sealed set: tools/gold/heldout.json held_out and held_out_r5, tools/gold/heldout-r5-repos.json, tools/ground_truth/cve_pairs.json, tools/gold/benchmarks.json
criteria.not_assessed: a pair whose files cannot be fetched at both commits, or whose scan fails, is counted as not assessed and left out of the denominator; the count is reported

scoring.matching_cwe: gt_common.cwe_match(finding.cwe, pair.in_scope_cwes, CWE_ALIASES); project-level rules (cve_pairs.PROJECT_RULES) ignored
scoring.recall_primary_hunk: a matching finding on the vulnerable side within 3 lines of a hunk the fix changed (old-side lines [start-3, stop+3); an add-only hunk is the insertion point between old lines i and i+1, widened the same way)
scoring.recall_secondary_function: a matching finding in the vulnerable side's enclosing function of a changed hunk (arbiter.context.function_span); outside any function, the primary region
scoring.recall_secondary_file: a matching finding anywhere in a file the fix changed
scoring.fixed_side_persistence: of primary-detected pairs, those where every matching primary finding is still reported on the fixed side (same rule, within 2 lines of the mapped new-side hunk, or on a line with the same stripped text): a likely false-positive or partial-fix signal, not proof
scoring.intervals: Wilson 95% and a repository-cluster percentile bootstrap (2000 resamples, seeded); effective sample size p(1-p)/var_bootstrap
scoring.reporting: development: per pair, per language, per (language, CWE); sealed: per language and overall aggregates only
